text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 30, 2024) for 16 Neilor Crescent.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 30, 2024) for 16 Neilor Crescent, Folder Number 24 205641 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
